/bin/zsh -lc 'cat tasklist/cli.py tasklist/tasks.py tasklist/__init__.py tests/test_tasks.py; git ls-files; python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v'

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -B - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
for base in (Path('tasklist/__pycache__'), Path('tests/__pycache__')):
    for path in base.glob('*.pyc'):
        path.unlink()
    base.rmdir()
pages = [Path('README.md'), Path('delivery.md'), Path('docs/task-completion.md'), Path('docs/work/investigation/repeated-completion.md')]
count = 0
for page in pages:
    text = page.read_text()
    for target in re.findall(r'\\[["'^'"\\]]+\\]\\((["'^)]+)'"\\)', text):
        assert (page.parent / target.split('#')[0]).is_file(), (page, target)
        count += 1
    assert all(line == line.rstrip() for line in text.splitlines()), page
print(f'Validated {count} local links and whitespace in {len(pages)} documentation files.')
PY
 git diff --check; git status --short"
